remarks: Newly constructed in 2021, this 1-bedroom, 1-bathroom apartment at Darien Place blends 1928 architectural charm with the ease of modern living. Soaring ceilings, exposed brick, and oversized windows create a striking first impression that bathes the apartment in natural light, while sleek Bosch appliances and custom privacy shades deliver everyday comfort.  The spacious ensuite bedroom features a full bath with a modern glass stall shower and in-unit washer/dryer designed for both style and convenience. Includes a reserved parking space in the parking lot, and a dedicated storage unit on the main level. Secure building with elevator and controlled access.  Located in the heart of downtown Darien-just steps from the train, cafes, restaurants, shops, and more. No smoking. Pet restrictions apply-please inquire.
